_comment: Measured by tools/fit-x1-edge.py from the reference fisheye circles listed below. uSamples is a normalised radius: 1.0 is each circle's own per-azimuth-registered edge landmark (the half-plateau crossing), NOT the frame half-width and NOT the model's u = 1. Multiply by a circle's alignScale to get the u that Edge.terminator / Edge.rimBell expect. base/baseSlope are the measured source content as a per-channel linear ramp in uSamples (value at rho = 1, plus d/drho), profR is the renderer's prof.r for that band -- the blurred content highlight weight that drives the glow -- so the model reconstructed from this fixture is COMPOSITE_FS exactly.
